answer: Each agent attests a fingerprint of its model and runtime, and the ledger publishes the hash on a public trellis, so two identities claiming one machine are visible. Rewards vest against the next thirty epochs of work, so a flagged clone loses the future, not just the moment. Example: 200 accounts on one host share a fingerprint and all 200 stop vesting at once. The vine cannot climb a ridge it does not own, and buying 200 hosts is the real cost.
